title: Heap overflow in HTTP/2 header decoder
description: A crafted HTTP/2 HEADERS frame can overflow a fixed decoder buffer. Daybreak Codex Security reproduced a crash in the sandbox and sketched a path to process memory corruption when the proxy is internet-facing.

validation.evidence: Sandbox crash on malformed HEADERS frame; ASAN report attached in Daybreak case.

remediation.summary: Bound frame->len against sizeof(buf) before copy; add a regression test from the Daybreak PoC.
